summary: Network-1 Technologies filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026 reporting that its board declared a routine semi-annual cash dividend of $0.05 per common share on September 3, 2026, payable September 28, 2026 to holders of record September 17, 2026. The declaration follows the company's existing dividend policy, which undergoes periodic board review and remains subject to change based on cash position, financial requirements and earnings. No advisor, premium, stake or regulatory clock is implicated. This is an ordinary capital-return event rather than a special situation; watch for policy sustainability given the patent-licensing cash-flow base.
